‘The human insulin receptor's tyrosine kinase activity is
sential for the mediation of insulin action in cells (reviewed
in ref, 1). This was most clearly shown by the analysis of a
‘variety of point mutations inthe conserved ATP-binding site
‘of the cytoplasmic domain (2-4) For example, the replace
‘meat of Lys-1018 with alanine eliminated the tyrosine kinase
activity and coincidentally abrogated a number of insulin-
‘dependent physiological effects (1-5). Thus, insight into the
rogulation of this kinase activity is critical for a further
‘understanding of insulin action.
